Name: Simple Mine Loot
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]⛏ Simple Mine Loot[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 Thank you for supporting my mods! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Mod Requested By: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url][/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Add extra loot chests, crates and barrels to your mine runs, with adjustable rewards and floor spawn chances.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#FDE68A][b]PC test prototype.[/b] Test on a copied save. Live procedural-floor gameplay, full-modpack, mid-day save/load and physical-controller testing remain pending.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]Extra loot containers:[/b] find bonus chests, crates and barrels on ordinary Mines and Skull Cavern floors. Toggle each type and location separately.
• [b]Adjust the floor chance:[/b] choose 0–100%, with 100% as the default. One roll is made per generated floor; clear space is still required.
• [b]Choose how much loot:[/b] set container counts, loot entries and quantities within the ranges below. Enabled container types are chosen randomly.
• [b]Depth-based rewards:[/b] deeper floors unlock stronger rewards when progression is enabled. Choose loot categories and whether rare rewards are allowed.
• [b]Collect naturally:[/b] open chests with the normal action button, or break crates and barrels with tools, weapons or explosions.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257896-1182844786.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🆕 Version 1.1[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]More reliable placement:[/b] containers no longer miss an available safe position because of repeated random guesses. Blocked floors can still limit how many fit.
• [b]Know why a floor was skipped:[/b] use [b]sml_status[/b] in the SMAPI console to see the last placement result, including disabled settings, protected floors, chance rolls, missing loot or insufficient space. It does not generate or refill loot.
• [b]Check the loot pool:[/b] GMCM shows how many curated pool entries are eligible at your current mine depth, before item creation. Repeated rewards are possible.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]⚙ Loot Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Floor chance:[/b] 100% default · adjustable 0–100%
[b]Containers per successful floor:[/b] 1–2 default · adjustable 1–10
[b]Loot entries per container:[/b] 1–3 default · adjustable 1–20
[b]Quantity per entry:[/b] 1–5 default · adjustable 1–50
Equipment stays at one per entry. Repeated item selections are possible.

[b]On by default:[/b] resources & ore, minerals, geodes and monster loot.
[b]Off by default:[/b] food, artifacts, equipment and rare loot.
Artifacts and equipment also require Rare loot. Disabling progression removes depth limits, while category and rare-loot switches still apply.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257905-1442433211.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🎒 How to Use[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Enter a [b]newly generated ordinary floor[/b]. Open a bonus chest to collect its items; it does not accept deposits. Break crates or barrels to drop their loot on the ground. Re-entering the same floor does not refill it.

Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings. Without GMCM, close the game and edit config.json after first launch. Changes apply to future floor attempts. Run [b]sml_status[/b] while on a mine floor to inspect its last attempt. Placed counts describe that original attempt, including containers already collected or removed before saving.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257896-1554226618.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]ℹ Before You Play[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Collect loot before leaving.[/b] Bonus containers are temporary: unloaded or reset floors lose them, and tracked bonus containers are removed before saving. They are not permanent storage.

[b]PC single-player only.[/b] Multiplayer and split-screen are inactive. Reward/treasure rooms, infested and dinosaur floors, Quarry Mine, custom side branches and Volcano Dungeon are excluded. Existing generated floors are not filled retroactively.

Loot comes from curated vanilla item pools; arbitrary modded-item pools are not included. Live modded-map, full-modpack and mid-day save/load testing remain pending.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/url][/b]. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Extract [b]SimpleMineLoot[/b] into [b]Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Previews[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. Translations are AI-assisted and await native-speaker proofreading.

Preview images are isolated native renders, not live gameplay. The mine scene uses a stock layout with controlled container positions. Game artwork is loaded from your installed game. Generative AI was used for code, settings text, translations and this page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include your mod/game/SMAPI versions and platform, expected versus actual behaviour, steps to reproduce and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. A screenshot or short video can help. For suggestions, explain what you would change and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
